proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.saveAdvantageIf
proposed_widenings.justification: The save_gate ActivationPhase has no field for a conditional advantage modifier on the target's saving throw. The spell grants advantage on the save under a specific combat-state predicate (caster or allies fighting the target), which is a distinct mechanical fact from the save itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it."

proposed_widenings.name: Duration.break_trigger (or timed + conditional_break)
proposed_widenings.justification: The timed Duration type has no mechanism to express an early-break condition triggered by a game event. The v4 lifecycle atom `break` exists but the TS surface exposes no field on Duration or on the persisted EffectAtom to attach a damage-triggered break. A new variant like `{ kind: 'timed'; value: DurationValue; breakIf?: BreakCondition }` or a separate `break_trigger` surface type is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "...the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it."

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment creature-type filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The target Attachment has no field to restrict the valid creature types. Charm Person targets only Humanoids; this restriction is currently unrepresentable and is silently dropped. A `creatureTypeFilter` field on the target attachment (or a new attachment variant) would close the gap.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "One Humanoid you can see within range..."

notes: Core mechanic (WIS save_gate → apply_condition: charmed, timed 1 hour, slot-scaled target count) encodes cleanly and typechecks + traces without errors. Three mechanics are dropped: (1) conditional advantage on the save roll, (2) damage-triggered early break on the condition, (3) Humanoid-only creature-type restriction. All three need new variants of existing surface types — no new v4 atoms are required. The 'Friendly' attitude and post-spell awareness text are narrative/DM-agenda and correctly omitted.
